reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 29. Nay or No: 11. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 34 (85%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Moderate Republicans will magically rediscover their @freedomcaucus principles the minute we're back in the minority.

Why wait? We've still got a majority and time to put those principles to a vote. https://t.co/sOyBflDV0t

Maybe the moderate Republicans packing up their offices in January will finally find the courage to take the votes they spent two years avoiding.

After all, you can't protect a seat you've already lost. https://t.co/u4x0N95bw3

I told my colleagues in January that running on tax cuts from last year wouldn't be enough to win in November.

Americans wanted Congress to put Americans first. 

Not only did they fall short, but they started rolling back the few wins Americans got. 👇
https://t.co/DWVp2SzRYW

“Government policies restrict competition, distort prices, reward inefficiency, and encourage consolidation.”

Get Washington out of the way. https://t.co/M3Jv8SfKWd

The American people don't have the luxury of sitting around analyzing what went wrong. They've got mortgages to pay, families to feed and health insurance premiums that keep climbing. They get up every morning, put their work boots on and do what needs to be done.

Congress ought to try it.

The average family health insurance policy now costs more than $28,000 a year. 

Republicans have two months left to do something about it. My Great American Healthcare Act follows President Trump's call to GIVE THE MONEY TO THE PEOPLE, not the medical cartel.

GO. BIG. https://t.co/NuH6rgVoIj

We owe an incredible debt of gratitude to the brave men and women who have served our nation.

It was a privilege to celebrate and honor so many of you at this year's Fishing Dreams in Southwest Missouri.

Happy Veterans Day! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/nkLZF8BF7z

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan and the House Republican leadership team elected today.

Jim helped found the @freedomcaucus to challenge the Washington establishment and the concentration of power in congressional leadership.

The American people are tired of watching Washington

Happy 251st birthday to the United States Marine Corps!

Since 1775, the U.S. Marine Corps has faithfully defended our nation against threats from across the globe. Every American owes them a debt of gratitude.

To all Marines, we thank you for your service! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/jRTK1bjnfb

It's always an honor to spend the day at Fishing Dreams and recognize the men and women who have served our country.

Their service and sacrifice deserve our deepest gratitude, and I'm grateful for another opportunity to celebrate them in such a beautiful part of the Ozarks. https://t.co/xWS8OrYJQC

Trump on the Senate: "I wish they could get more produced."

Fact Check: True ✅ https://t.co/g4Wfrv7jbD

The agenda of the Republican Party can no longer revolve around saving moderates who openly reject conservative policy.

Our party's new leaders need to put Americans first without compromise. https://t.co/tj9MJspaCD

The Freedom Caucus championed bold ideas on healthcare reform, housing, and affordability.

Leadership met our appeals with blank stares and chose instead to cater to moderates unwilling to take the “difficult votes” needed to advance the America First Agenda. https://t.co/PjMP6QMoZ8

We have 60 days to show the American people that Congress can still deliver.

Nobody wants to hear excuses. Let's get it done. https://t.co/AATuKFCZ2k

Republicans have two months to deliver on the promises we made to the American people.

We have the tools to get it done, but it's going to take hard work and urgency to get it across the finish line. https://t.co/GDR9lKEK5B

Congress overwhelmingly chose to "play it safe" instead of delivering on the mandate voters sent them to Washington to fulfill.

Leadership prioritized political calculations to save moderate seats rather than saving the country.

What good is a majority if you don't use it? https://t.co/kpJFrLQ6lJ

Week after week, Americans sent Congress the same message: Go big or go home.

There were multiple opportunities to meet that moment. Instead, leadership repeatedly chose moderation or failed to address the core issues facing the American people. https://t.co/23Bkfn0Eog

Republicans need to spend the next few months bulletproofing Congress from the DSA agenda before January.  
Take away as many opportunities for them to attach garbage to must-pass legislation. https://t.co/GOf4WMW7Y6

Playing it safe on major issues got House Republicans nowhere.

Watch my election recap and thoughts on the road ahead with @tperkins 👇 https://t.co/Mk5u0OEQ3h
The Senate could still pass the SAVE America Act before January if they were willing to sacrifice vacation time and save the country.

With major issues still on the table before the end of the year, Congress has work to do.
 
Passing the SAVE Act, delivering real healthcare reform, and getting our nation’s finances under control must remain priorities.
 
I joined @TheTonus to break it down. https://t.co/BW4zM0rWaL

When government-run healthcare is projected to push premiums up 13% next year, Democrats’ answer is… more government?
 
Government expansion only makes problems worse.
 
Republicans need to restore choice, competition, and transparency in healthcare before it's too late.

When the government pays the tab, nobody cares what it costs.

The Great American Healthcare Act restores price transparency and empowers Americans to pick the care that best fits their needs. https://t.co/BehNzTAS5X

It should be abundantly clear by now that ALPRs and the surveillance state will only be used to extract as much revenue as possible from law-abiding citizens through parking tickets, traffic fines, and arbitrary taxes.

Of course, the abuses won't end there. https://t.co/czdAxKqWcD
Exactly 👇 https://t.co/G4gWRRMIzl

Something has to change. 

My Great American Healthcare Act brings the free market back to healthcare, putting patients in charge of their own money and giving families the freedom to shop around for better care at lower prices. https://t.co/WLtpUwxNBQ

Total scam. 

Taxpayers deserve way better than this. https://t.co/3Y7nCU8P5h

Homeownership. Affordable healthcare. A government that lives within its means.

Congress needs to focus on bringing the American dream back within reach for young Americans. https://t.co/Yze0SU05Yu
Huge win 🇺🇸 https://t.co/jdzDPXKQOC

Many young Americans understand there’s little point in paying high premiums to subsidize the healthcare of other people when they get to own nothing in return.

It’s a crap deal when others get it for free or cheap via subsidies.

We need serious healthcare reform. https://t.co/yi3a0UUFBU

Americans didn’t “opt in” to the Flock camera in their neighborhood, the spyware now being mandated for new cars, or warrantless surveillance under FISA 702.
 
The right to privacy is unalienable, and conservatives must defend it.

https://t.co/005oltHscI

If Democrats gain control of Congress, expect them to push aggressively for mass amnesty, attaching it to as much legislation as possible.
 
Republicans must stand firm and refuse to cave under any circumstances.
Bold strategy, Cotton. https://t.co/rJV7JoXFh0

Young Americans are priced out of the lives their parents once lived.

The participation ticket in American society is much more expensive than it used to be: buying a home, healthcare, starting a family, etc.

Perennial issues that cannot be ignored. https://t.co/2pbxsIWpye

Real price transparency, expanded eligibility for HSAs, and increased competition across the healthcare marketplace sounds like music to our ears.

The Great American Health Care Act aims to give Americans more options and greater flexibility in managing their healthcare costs.

Read more here: https://t.co/rBZsqIESiC

Last week, I had the privilege of spending time with our veterans at Honor Flight of the Ozarks.

Hearing their stories and thanking them personally is always a reminder of the incredible sacrifices these men and women made for our country. https://t.co/SQIENUHC0g

Obamacare was built to break.  
If we don't fix it, Democrats will use its failure to justify total government intervention in healthcare.
 
Republicans cannot ignore the issue any longer.
👇 https://t.co/Y9dLxgatrb

What if your healthcare savings could help cover qualifying healthy food and fitness expenses, not just medical bills?

The Great American Healthcare Act would expand the expenses eligible for Health Savings Account funds, giving families more flexibility to invest in their health.

Read more here: https://t.co/rBZsqIESiC

Democrats spent years weaponizing the justice system against their political opponents. Suddenly, they don't like the game they started.

The hypocrisy of the Left is absurd. https://t.co/febJ94Fbuw

If Republicans fail to fix Obamacare’s failing infrastructure and restore consumer choice, Democrats will seize the opportunity to push for totally socialized medicine.

The longer we wait, the worse it gets.

The problem is not going away 👇
https://t.co/7MD25NXv0p
https://t.co/JoEvmfNnWd

Democratic policies only amount to higher taxes, more regulations, and government spending.  

Read my latest in the @dcexaminer 👇 https://t.co/jVeRpuvXo1

Breakthroughs in advanced technology could reshape the balance of power at critical global flashpoints.

In a race with major national security implications, the U.S. cannot afford to fall behind on disclosure. https://t.co/EwgaiikJwy

AI advancement creates tremendous opportunities for small businesses and local ranchers alike. But the government shouldn't dictate how that progress happens.

Let local communities decide what’s best for them—not federal funding steering development from the top down. https://t.co/dCeKOG9W8n

From AI-assisted heifer insemination in Southwest Missouri to the international UFO arms race.

Quite the range of topics for a morning on @FoxBusiness with @dagenmcdowell. https://t.co/wtjQLz5ajB
It was great to speak at the OTO Annual Legislative Meeting. I appreciate the work this organization does to plan and coordinate transportation projects across our region. https://t.co/MB30q1F33l
What value does an international election monitoring group provide when they lament the supposed "dangers" of voter ID in the United States? https://t.co/9kz2Kq0Vng

More options for local producers. Less unnecessary federal red tape.

Solid legislation from @RepThomasMassie. Happy to support it. https://t.co/GMsUeeICKp
We could just get rid of NFA and ATF altogether, seeing that they only exist to punish law-abiding gun owners.
https://t.co/JQPNVCSZ6J

Much has been revealed, but many questions remain unanswered.

If Congress isn't allowed to know the truth, who is?

Watch my full interview with @jordanflowers and me on with @DrPhil on YouTube. https://t.co/La7sugnVtr

The dismantling of the NFA has been over a year in the making and would not have been possible without the members who backed the legislation, 2A gun groups, and President Trump.

A truly incredible win for gun owners. https://t.co/uRyfx3B8oo

Allegations of massive fraud involving taxpayer dollars demand answers.

Follow the evidence. Expose the truth. Hold the guilty accountable. https://t.co/rf9P4mh9QG

Democrats think that they can ride pocketbook concerns to victory, but Americans should beware: Democrats’ policies would only raise the cost of living, not lower it.

Read my latest op-ed in the @dcexaminer 👇
https://t.co/JoEvmfMQ6F
https://t.co/JoEvmfMQ6F

Talk is cheap. Liberal policies are expensive. Just ask Illinois.

Democratic policies only amount to higher taxes, more regulations, and government spending.

Read my latest in the @dcexaminer https://t.co/CYUPy9Op7a

Pass HR 335 and abolish the NFA.

We must secure these rights permanently across all 50 states. https://t.co/krTeQNa5WB

If you're 25 years old, the federal government hasn't balanced its budget in your lifetime.

Washington has spent an entire generation operating in the red.

Pathetic! https://t.co/gNzo5uB3ec

For years, Table Rock Lake property owners have dealt with unnecessary federal interference.

We took the fight to the Trump administration, and the Army Corps finally changed its position. https://t.co/GLFlfVxFuL

Washington has no shortage of politicians who talk about cutting spending and limiting government.

The @freedomcaucus exists to make sure those principles survive in the swamp. https://t.co/B7Ajv6FEJT

The Second Amendment is not a guideline. It is a constitutional guarantee that no government can disregard.

Congress must repeal the National Firearms Act and uphold every American's right to keep and bear arms. https://t.co/KoZKeQGbVp

I fought to zero out the NFA tax stamp, then pushed the ATF, after the August ruling, to extend relief to all Americans—not just the plaintiffs.

A historic win for the 2A community, but the fight isn’t over. Congress must repeal the NFA and make these freedoms permanent. https://t.co/jHYGoVwEVv

Great visit to Springfield Underground, a locally owned, family-run business that's turned a former limestone mine into a major hub for warehousing and distribution.

An incredible example of Missouri innovation and the important role our local businesses play in America's supply chain.

We were grateful to welcome a professional harpist and GRAMMY representative to our office last week for Music Advocacy Day!

Thank you for sharing your incredible talent and helping highlight the importance of music and the arts in our communities. https://t.co/zF0D7yHSQy

Monumental victory for 2A rights and Americans across the country.

Congratulations to all who made their voices heard and relentlessly pursued legal clarity.

🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸 https://t.co/Z7uBbtOqgY

Enjoyed meeting with members of Sho-Me Power Electric Cooperative today at Bennett Springs. 

Very pleased with the electric cooperatives in our district. They do a great job powering our homes and businesses. https://t.co/SwJnOGhvrD

Team Burlison recently hosted our annual agriculture tour, this year in Taney County. We had a great day with the local ag community, including a stop at @CofOHardWorkU.

Our farmers are the backbone of Southwest Missouri, and Washington would do well to listen to them more often.

This summer, Branson set a Guinness World Record for the largest flag mosaic logo as part of the community’s celebration of America’s 250th anniversary.

Great to stop by the Branson/Lakes Area Chamber of Commerce and see one of the flags that helped put the Ozarks in the record books.

It was great to visit with students from the GO CAPS Tri-Lakes program. 

GO CAPS gives high school juniors and seniors from Branson, Reeds Spring, Hollister, and across the Tri-Lakes region hands-on career experience and professional development. https://t.co/pHP5qEFKVy

Great visit to Red Monkey Foods in Springfield. 

A local manufacturer that adds a little spice to southwest Missouri and makes products sold across the country. https://t.co/Mv61KvbhL5

Our farmers should have more options to process and sell the livestock they raise. 

Glad to cosponsor this bill with @RepThomasMassie. https://t.co/uw2QG9rdZ4
National Manufacturing Day is a reminder that American industry depends on affordable energy, reliable supply chains, and a government that gets out of the way. https://t.co/WEWUb69z5v

DOJ just made it official: it will not appeal the Texas ruling against suppressor registration.

On Fresh Freedom, @Rep_Clyde took us behind the scenes of the push that helped get there—including his personal call to President Trump. https://t.co/7YEvNjWDz3
Congress zeroed out the NFA tax. A federal judge struck down the registration requirement for the affected firearms. Now DOJ has made it official: it will not appeal. https://t.co/DJXA5MptSF
